sources.beginner: crude density hand-calc except an unstated 15.56 C reference; the other five need the water viscosity/density fits whose constants no lesson prints; panels (WaterExplorer.jsx) run only the teaching stream; Suite Produced Water Treatment studio unnamed and prints 1-3 dp
sources.intermediate: turndown, shear penalty and bed cut are exact hand-calcs from intermediate m03/m05; cyclone cut, bubble rise and holdup need the undisclosed fluid fits (DeviceExplorer.jsx runs KOKORI only)
sources.advanced: all six need the undisclosed fluid fits plus a 60-bin train integration; TrainExplorer.jsx runs only the teaching train

fix.redesign: No new quantity: state the reference temperature the 0.0007 per degree thinning is measured from (15.56 C) in the lesson and the prompt; the field then becomes an exact hand-calc.

fields.recommendation: State 15.56 C explicitly (prompt amendment); widening tol to 0.003 would contradict the six-decimal instruction.
fields.evidence: The lesson teaches 141.5/(131.5 + API) x 999 thinned at 0.0007 per degree, but never states the reference temperature. The engine uses 15.56 C (packages/engines/engines/facilities/producedWater.js:323); the exact 60 F = 15.5556 C a learner would use gives 862.321424, 0.0028 from 862.324190 against tol 1e-4.
fields.notes: Recoverable only by back-solving the lesson table (API 24 at 41 C = 892.869375). The three panels are fixed to the teaching streams (UZERE, KOKORI and the train stream; producedWaterLab.js:2048 'NO PANEL' may carry the capstone, capstoneLeak.test.js) and offer only view/preset selects. The Suite Produced Water Treatment studio accepts every input but is never named, takes temperature in F, and prints viscosity to 3 dp in cp and densities to 1 dp (/opt/petrolord-studio/workspaces/dev1/projects/petrolord-suite/src/components/pwtstudio/PwtPanels.jsx:238-242, fields.jsx:28), far short of the stated precision.
